title: Whether a seed lot or plant is the variety it is said to be: its genetic match to that variety's registered reference profile, from a laboratory's marker genotyping. Slot 0 is the match in percent times 100 (99.20 % is 9920). Slot 3 is the registration or certificate number of the variety, digits only. Slot 4 is the marker panel: 1 BARCSoySNP6K (soybean), 2 the maize SNP set of the International Seed Federation guidelines, 3 the 56-SNP soybean identity set of Argentina's INASE, 0 another panel, named in the laboratory's report. The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
